extracted_decision.summary: Adopt autopilot baseline mode for new tasks: plan first, then fix automatically, then extract the Manager's decisions from the old and new task and save them.
extracted_decision.rationale: Manager locked autopilot baseline mode as the required workflow.

Skip decision extraction at the end
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Automates fixes but relies on later QA and review gates to catch defects; Adds a decision-extraction step at the end of the cycle
